KKR’s Global Impact Fund originally co-established the platform, which provides water quality and nutrient removal infrastructure, and the sale advances CRH’s expansion as a North American water infrastructure provider.

sourceEvidence.title: SK Group Renewable Energy JV | KKR
sourceEvidence.evidenceSummary: SK and KKR signed a renewable-energy business transfer agreement covering solar and wind assets, with KKR expected to participate through asset acquisitions and capital contributions into an integrated renewable-energy entity. The deal adds sponsor capital to a Korean renewable platform with operating and development exposure.

sourceEvidence.title: Helix Digital Infrastructure | KKR
sourceEvidence.evidenceSummary: KKR launched Helix Digital Infrastructure with partners as a new company to finance and deliver AI infrastructure. The platform announced more than $10bn of commitments targeting data centers, power, transmission and distribution, fiber, and connectivity assets.
